items.label: Recursion Q2 FY2026 (08-05-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Genentech advanced the collaboration's first previously unexplored

set.signal: Genentech advanced the collaboration's first previously unexplored neuroscience target into a joint early-discovery program. Recursion reported more than $260 million in upfront and milestone payments to date and potential for more than $300 million of additional development, commercialization and sales milestones for each future small-molecule program. The to-date figure is as transcribed in the call transcript; the same-day filed release and deck print a different to-date figure (see the Recursion 8-K (08-05-2026) contract on this edge).
set.value: >$260M received to date as transcribed (the filed release figure differs); >$300M potential per future program

items.reason: Call transcript (Alpha Vantage) says 'more than $260 million'; the 8-K release and deck filed the same day say $216 million. Kept as the call states (possible STT error), with a pointer to the filed figure - same handling as the 2026-09-11 call-figure fixes (edgar_r3_call_figure_fixes).
